summary_original: Earlier this year, Pokémon Champions for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 received a higher age rating in Germany and Brazil than in certain other regions due to regional age classification requirements. Pokémon Champions Junior, which features a lower age rating to ensure younger players can participate in Championship Series events, will release on Nintendo eShop in Germany and Brazil on September 9, 2026 .
